# Area: standins

Started by the build lead from this brief (2026-11-13). It is the definition of done.

Josh's decision (Nov 13): every art slot that draws in game gets its best existing candidate now as a stand-in, even if it has not passed; that beats gray placeholders. It is NOT a pass: the inventory, the bar and every pass record stay measured passes only.
Do: (1) python3 tools/build/art_slots.py list: the slots with a consumer (not '(-)'). (2) For each slot's piece, find the best existing candidate across the lane worktrees (read-only: ../<lane>/pipeline/art/proof/, ../<lane>/pipeline/art/critic/<piece>.json records and panel logs; and main's): the round with the best panel result (most pairs ours/same, then the highest art_ref_check score), else the latest round. Skip any piece that already has a verified pass (python3 tools/build/art_pass_verify.py check) and anything that is a byte or near copy of pre-jam reference art. (3) Copy the image into this lane under Art/Source/StandIns/<piece>/ and import it into the slot's existing _PH texture with tools/build/assets/import_art_candidate.py (keep the _PH name, so it stays a tracked placeholder; never write a .artloop.json pass record). (4) Write pipeline/art/standins.json: per slot the piece, the source path and lane, the round, the panel result and score, the sha256, and status 'best-so-far (not passed)'. Add provenance rows for the copied files (origin: the candidate's own origin, 'stand-in, not passed'). (5) Batch per family (Ella, Keeper, scene backgrounds, shots and effects, enemies, UI): commit a family, PRECHECK_FAST=1 bash tools/build/lane_precheck.sh standins --bg until PASS, then commit so the gate takes it; next family. Never touch another lane's worktree files, references.json, approvals.json or pass records. Report at the end: how many slots got a stand-in, per family, and which drawn slots had no candidate at all.
